Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Furry Fury]]: the lines "Heav'n has no Rage, like Love to Hatred turn'd, / Nor Hell a Fury, like a Woman scorn'd." on page 39 of the first edition (1697) of William Congreve's play ''The Mourning Bride''. Cropped from the page scan.

Source: page 57 of [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Mourning_Bride_-_Congreve_(1697,_1st_ed).djvu The Mourning Bride - Congreve (1697, 1st ed).djvu], Wikimedia Commons, scanned from the Internet Archive item mourningbridetra00cong. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260106191002/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Mourning_Bride_-_Congreve_(1697,_1st_ed).djvu Internet Archive], 6 January 2026.
